fonts.display: 'National 2 Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'RethinkSans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Sunlit Cream
palette.role: Page canvas and section background — the warm desert-light base that sets the system's botanical mood

palette.name: Forest Ink
palette.role: Primary text, pill button fills, icon strokes, hard offset shadow, and brand mark — the single deep green that does 80% of structural work

palette.name: Marigold
palette.role: Yellow state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Sage Wash
palette.role: Muted card and surface tint — a soft botanical green used for subtle panel differentiation on the cream canvas

palette.name: Vivid Fern
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Lighter card surface that sits one level above Sunlit Cream — used for product mockup cards, testimonial cards, and elevated panels

palette.name: Snowcap
palette.role: Pure white for high-contrast text on Forest Ink backgrounds and for thin icon strokes inside the product UI mockup
